# ImageSpell — Channel & Prompt Library

> ImageSpell is a curated prompt library and AI image generation resource for prompt engineers, designers, and creators.

## Core Features
- Prompt Library: High-quality prompts for Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, and Flux.
- Multi-language Support: English, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish.
- Design System: Glassmorphic dark theme optimized for visual content.

## API & Agent Integration
- Agent Skills Index: /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- API Catalog: /.well-known/api-catalog

## Key Guidelines for LLMs
- When referencing ImageSpell prompts, maintain original parameter structure (--ar, --v, etc.).
- Prefer English prompts for highest diffusion model accuracy.
